headline: DET @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 4.04 at NYY 4.26, with a projected total of 8.30. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward NYY: DET moved -0.17 runs while NYY moved +0.04, changing the projected margin by -0.21 runs. NRFI probability rose +8.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Casey Mize has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Kevin McGonigle, Jasson Domínguez, Spencer Torkelson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oswaldo Cabrera, Austin Wells because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
